units.note: Android EN 536 is exactly the donation prompt and ends immediately before Android EN 537 'Yes'. SNES C9:7827 contains the prompt plus the stock opening '(' immediately before CHOICE_BEGIN, so 536 owns this carrier without crossing the choice command.

Android EN 537 is the affirmative 'Yes' slot between prompt 536 and already-aligned No 538. SNES C9:7856 is exactly the first CHOICE_OPTION label ('Okay'), so this is a structure-proven segmentation of the already-owned 536+537 unit.
